closedDefect.defect: the qualifier read durable history once, then awaited the DSH header read, then returned without rechecking the store — so a conflict appended during the read yielded a stale ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED

steps: capture store.head() BEFORE any asynchronous source read
replay the attempt's durable events and record their count
validate source epoch, canonical Work, window integrity and cardinality
await the official DSH header read
re-read the store head and the attempt's events
if the head changed AND the attempt's event set changed, return RACED
protocol.note: an unrelated-project change advances the global head but not the attempt's event set, so it does NOT spuriously produce RACED; a relevant change always does

outcome: RACED is a distinct qualification state; it never returns a stale ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED
tests: P2C C2 §6.7 a conflict appended during the Header read yields RACED, never a stale qualification
P2C C2 §6.7 an unrelated change does not disturb a stable qualification
